intro: Short videos that show Virtual Church Musician at work and teach you each app step by step. Every video has captions and a written transcript.

videos.title: Virtual Church Musician in about two and a half minutes
videos.blurb: A quick tour: how the Server, the apps and your sound system fit together, and what a service looks like from planning to Play.

videos.title: Ready when you are
videos.blurb: A short film about the Sunday the organist could not come. Scenes are dramatized and created with AI.

videos.title: Connecting to your church's Server
videos.blurb: Find the Server, request enrollment, and get approved. The same steps for every app.

videos.title: The Administration Console
videos.blurb: Set up the Server, approve and manage devices, and learn what each screen is for.

videos.title: Building a template
videos.blurb: Create, edit, clone and version a reusable starting point for your services.

videos.title: Building and publishing a service
videos.blurb: Put together an order of service for a date, fix any red items, and publish it, without losing your work.

videos.title: Running a service
videos.blurb: Load today's service and press Play. What to do if the connection drops.

sections.title: On an Android phone or tablet

videos.title: Installing and connecting on Android
videos.blurb: Install the app from its download file and connect to your church's Server.
videos.audience: Everyone on a phone or tablet

videos.title: Approving a device from your phone
videos.blurb: Use the Security app to approve, reject and suspend devices away from the server computer.

videos.title: Templates and services on a phone
videos.blurb: The Template Editor and Service Builder on a touch screen, and what is different from the computer.

videos.title: Running a service from your phone
videos.blurb: The Service Runner setup card, playing items, and reconnecting.
